title: Carolina Guide Service - Fishing Charters

services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: With another successful South Carolina tarpon season in the books, I was fortunate to experience some incredible moments that I will never forget. I offer tarpon fishing charters beginning in June and will continue to fish for tarpon until mid late October when they begin their migration back south. All of our tarpon fishing charters depart out of Georgetown where we have access to some of the most fertile tarpon fishing grounds on the east coast. With very little rainfall this year, I noticed a pattern shift due to the amount of baitfish that are normally found in the Winyah Bay vicinity. blurb: Carolina Guide Service offers fishing charters for anglers of all skill levels and we are dedicated to making your fishing adventure a memorable one. Capt. Jordan Pate and his network of first class fishing guides will lead you in search of redfish, trout, flounder, tarpon, sharks, cobia and other inshore species. The saltwater fishing grounds south of Myrtle Beach are some of the most pristine on the East Coast
